g.text: 0/5V positive logic, <=2mA per output, to EXTERNAL igniters only. NEVER connect a coil primary.

g.desc: 0/5V positive logic, <=2mA per output, to EXTERNAL igniters only. NEVER connect a coil primary.

g.text: Igniter polarity, dwell and Evo compatibility are unverified. Start with logic probes or LEDs only.

g.desc: Igniter polarity, dwell and Evo compatibility are unverified. Start with logic probes or LEDs only.

g.text: External igniter supply must come from switched+12V_ACT. No separate always-on supply.

g.desc: External igniter supply must come from switched+12V_ACT. No separate always-on supply.

g.text: SN74AHCT08 accepts3.3V TTL inputs and forces every ignition command low when ACT_EN=0.

g.desc: SN74AHCT08 accepts3.3V TTL inputs and forces every ignition command low when ACT_EN=0.
